_note: Higgsfield Cloud (platform.higgsfield.ai). submit(application=MODEL_ID_PATH, arguments={flat body}). Auth: HF_KEY='key:secret'. Reference image passed as image_url (string). Result: {'video':{'url':...}}. Model IDs are the URL paths from cloud.higgsfield.ai/explore. image_to_video below is confirmed from official docs; text_to_video + audio model IDs must be confirmed in the gallery.

video.audio_directive: Audio: realistic diegetic sound effects only (liquid splashes, subtle whooshes, soft ambient room tone) — absolutely no music, no soundtrack, no melody, no score.

audio._note: The Higgsfield cloud REST API exposes no plain text-to-speech model (only higgsfield-ai/speak, a talking-avatar that needs an image). Voiceovers are generated via the Higgsfield MCP (Claude), not the standalone engine. If a TTS model appears in cloud.higgsfield.ai/explore, put its slug in model_id to enable standalone VO.
